name: Shahed Aviation Industries Research Center
supervisors: Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Aerospace Force (IRGC ASF)

evidence.summary: The US Treasury describes the Shahed Aviation Industries Research Center (SAIRC) as subordinate to the Aerospace Force of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC ASF), for which it developed the Shahed-129 drone, and as the designer and maker of the Shahed-136 one-way attack drones Russian forces have used against civilian infrastructure in Ukraine. OFAC lists it, in Isfahan, as linked to the IRGC Air Force.
It belongs to the Aerospace Force of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC ASF).

sources.title: Treasury Targets Actors Involved in Production and Transfer of Iranian Unmanned Aerial Vehicles to Russia for Use in Ukraine (15 November 2022)

sources.publisher: US Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)
